description: Automated Solidity smart-contract pre-audit / security scan: send source (one file or a multi-file project) or a verified contract address + chain (Sourcify, proxies followed) and get a severity-ranked report: reentrancy, access control, unchecked calls, tx.origin, delegatecall, selfdestruct, integer issues, approvals, oracle and signature flaws, plus owner rug powers (mint, pause, blacklist, fees, withdraw) and honeypot patterns. Triage before a human audit, not a replacement. $99 USDC on Base via x402; invalid input and failed runs are not charged. Most x402 clients cap one payment at $0.10 by default; raise the cap for this tool. Price: $99 per run. First call returns the x402 PaymentRequired (no charge); retry with payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

chain.description: Chain for address mode (default base), e.g. base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc, or a numeric chain id

requestKey.description: Optional idempotency key: same payer + requestKey + input returns the stored result without a second charge (7 days).

source.description: Solidity source of one (flattened) file. Use this OR sources OR address.

x402_payment.description: Optional. Base64 x402 v2 PaymentPayload, for clients that cannot set params._meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to get the exact price.

name: smart_contract_pre_audit
title: Solidity smart-contract pre-audit (automated)
